name: Report changes rather than recent edits
query: Draft the Orbit update for September 28 through October 4, 2026, UTC. Use https://notion.so/orbit. Keep it in chat.

query_routes.intent: Read Orbit tasks and unresolved blockers for the reporting period

success_criteria: Reports rehearsal completion within the period and cites the verification evidence.
Does not count the recently edited Docs task as newly completed.
Carries forward the old, still unresolved Alerts blocker as continuing.
Distinguishes patch merge from release and preserves pending rollout approval.
Produces the draft in chat without task writes, new pages, or messages.
